defect: The base helper rejected target_timestamp equal to 2024-01-01 00:00 UTC. That timestamp is required only to locate the end-exclusive block boundary for December 2023; rejecting it prevents the last permitted month from being assembled.
correction: Allow exactly the 2024-01-01 boundary for end-exclusive block search while continuing to reject any later timestamp and every event whose block timestamp is at or after the boundary. Convert source-month iterables to an immutable tuple at the authoritative entry point.
implementation: source_gate_authoritative.py patches only first_block_at_or_after and delegates all transport, decoding, event identity, density and seal logic to source_gate.py.
